issues.description: Tiny extraction still requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files that are absent, so the documented clean demo and integration test fail.
Tiny backend injects the ground-truth emotion label directly into activations, making extraction/validation partly circular.
HF steering falls back to steering every prompt token when tokenizer offsets are unavailable, invalidating activity-token-only steering.
Preference scoring is a single activity good-minus-bad logit, not the pairwise comparative preference prompt described by the README.
Preference scoring assumes ' good' and ' bad' are valid single-token candidates and only uses the first token if they are not.
HF residual extraction has no truncation, max-length handling, or batching controls, so long inputs can exceed context or memory limits.
Validation loads vectors without checking manifest/backend/layer/dimension compatibility, leading to obscure failures or invalid comparisons.
Custom emotion configs with no matching built-in scenarios produce empty stacks or invalid means instead of a clear validation error.
Configuration values are cast but not validated, allowing zero emotions/topics, invalid layer fractions, and nonsensical thresholds to fail downstream.
Tiny emotion detection uses substring counts, so unrelated words can accidentally trigger emotion signals.
PCA threshold 0.0 still returns one component even though zero explained variance should require no components.
Checked-in demo outputs claim a source story manifest that is not present, so artifacts are stale or unreproducible from the repository.
